2610.09770.title: Artificial intelligence pathways from weather to climate
2610.09770.paper_summary: Deep learning has made rapid advances in weather forecasting: autoregressive models trained on atmospheric reanalyses now rival dynamical models across nowcasting, medium-range, and subseasonal-to-seasonal lead times, producing well-calibrated ensemble forecasts at reduced cost. We review these advances and consider their extension to climate horizons, where the challenge shifts from initial-condition skill to producing reliable statistical responses under altered forcings. AI-powered climate prediction systems must produce credible forced responses to drivers (e.g., greenhouse gases, land-use change) typically outside the observed record. We propose two minimum requirements for AI in climate modeling: (i) external forcing agents must enter explicitly enough to support interventions in which they vary independently; and (ii) robustness must be stress-tested in out-of-distribution regimes, including extremes and counterfactual trajectories. Using leading AI autoregressive emulators and hybrid physics-AI models, we identify development and coupling challenges. Comparing the reported throughput of these models with that of GPU-ported dynamical models highlights how AI can reduce time-to-solution by advancing only the target variables at the required resolution and using longer time steps, rather than integrating a full high-frequency, multivariate state. Diverse AI downscaling strategies can partially substitute for explicit fine-scale resolution, paving the way toward inexpensive local hazard assessment across prediction horizons.
2610.09770.paper_summary_zh: 深度學習在天氣預測方面取得了迅速的進展：基於大氣重分析訓練的自回歸模型現在在即時預測、中期預測以及季節內到季節的預測時間上與動力模型相媲美，並以降低成本產生良好校準的集合預測。我們回顧這些進展並考慮它們在氣候預測中的延伸，這裡的挑戰從初始條件的技能轉移到在改變的外部強迫下產生可靠的統計反應。人工智慧驅動的氣候預測系統必須對驅動因素（例如，溫室氣體、土地使用變化）產生可信的強迫反應，這些驅動因素通常超出了觀察記錄。我們提出了氣候建模中人工智慧的兩個最低要求：（i）外部強迫因子必須明確地進入，以支持它們獨立變化的干預；（ii）在分佈外的情境中必須進行壓力測試以確保穩健性，包括極端情況和反事實軌跡。利用領先的人工智慧自回歸模擬器和混合物理-人工智慧模型，我們確定了發展和耦合的挑戰。將這些模型的報告吞吐量與GPU移植的動力模型進行比較，突顯了人工智慧如何通過僅推進所需分辨率的目標變量並使用更長的時間步驟來減少解決時間，而不是整合完整的高頻多變量狀態。多樣的人工智慧降尺度策略可以部分替代明確的細尺度分辨率，為在預測範圍內進行低成本的當地危害評估鋪平道路。
